title.narrative: Bangladesh Health Watch 2024-2025 - Bangladesh Health Watch

description.narrative: Bangladesh Health Watch (BHW) is a civil society organizations working on transparency and monitoring of the health sector and its actors. BHW plays an important area for strengthening the voice of women and the public as well as demanding responsibility from the government and other decision makers. This is Sida's second project with BHW. The project will continue to promote a responsive health system with greater focus on accountability, including anti-corruption, especially at the local level. The proposed project will have three strategic objectives: 1) Strengthened local level accountability. 2) Strengthened media engagement and capacity to promote social accountability in health. 3) Strengthened advocacy work to accelerate the implementation of universal health coverage (UHC) by the government. During the proposed phase, local health forums of volunteers, will be a key vehicle to achieve stronger social accountability. Linked to this work, policy advocacy at the central level by the secretariat will complement.

Bangladesh Health Watch (BHW) är en civilsamhällesorganisation som arbetar med transparens och ansvarsutkrävande inom hälsosektorn. BHW spelar en viktig roll i att stärka medborgares röst gentemot regeringen och andra beslutsfattare, med ett särskilt fokus på kvinnligt deltagande. Detta är Sidas andra projekt med BHW. Projektet kommer att fortsätta att främja ett responsivt hälsosystem med större fokus på ansvarsutkrävande, inklusive anti-korruption, särskilt på lokal nivå. Projektet kommer att arbeta mot tre strategiska mål: 1) Stärkt ansvar på lokal nivå. 2) Stärkt medieengagemang och kapacitet att främja socialt ansvarstagande inom hälsa. 3) Stärkt påverkansarbete för att påskynda implementeringen av universell hälsotäckning (UHC) av regeringen. Under den föreslagna fasen kommer lokala hälsoforum, som samlar volontärer, att vara en en viktig plattform för att stärka socialt ansvarsutkrävande. Kopplat till detta arbete, kommer påverkansarbete koordineras av sekretariatet på nationell nivå.

The vision is that all citizens of Bangladesh enjoy universal health care (UHC) and the mission is to build a functional platform through which citizens and all other relevant stakeholders of the country can get their voices heard and thereby influence policies and programmes impacting citizen's health.
The overall goal is to contribute to increasing the health and productivity of the citizens of Bangladesh.
The proposed project will have three strategic objectives:
Objective 1: Strengthened local-level accountability
1.1 Systematise and strengthen public hearing and authority meetings
1.2 Institutionalise facility monitoring by Regional Chapter (RC) members
1.3 Strengthen RCs including Youth Forums
1.4 Enhance Host Organisation (HO) capacity and interest to support Regional Chapters
1.5 Strengthen ownership of RCs and HOs for sustainability
1.6 Improve attendance of service providers in health centres
Expected outcomes:
- Stronger RC platform to claim local level accountability from health service delivery system
- Concrete plan for post-project sustainability of initiatives at local level developed
- Improved quality of services at local level
- Increased people's voice
Objective 2: Strengthened media engagement and capacity to promote social accountability in health
2.1 Expand and strengthen local-level media partnership
2.2 Strengthen national-level media partnership
Expected outcomes:
- Increased participation of local journalists in social accountability activities (public hearings, campaigns, rallies)
- Increased coverage and impact of media reporting on health issues
Objective 3: Strengthened advocacy work to accelerate the implementation of UHC by the government
3.1 Evidence based advocacy for increased allocation to PHC in health budget
3.2 Use legal provisions for improving quality of specific areas of health services (Public Interest Litigation)
3.3 Facilitate the work of Anti-Corruption platform working on absenteeism and reducing medicine prices
Expected outcomes:
- Increased allocation for PHC in health sector budget
- High Court directives on selected issues of public health importance operationalized
- Public opinion created and policymakers mobilised to reduce absenteeism in government facilities and reduce medicine prices
The target group
The direct beneficiaries of the project will be the citizens of Bangladesh, especially the catchment's population (approx 15 million) of the eight Regional Chapters. The indirect beneficiaries will the health managers, service providers, and members of the various tiers for Regional Chapters.

tag.narrative: 1.1 - By 2030, eradicate extreme poverty for all people everywhere, currently measured as people living on less than $1.25 a day.
1.1 - Senast 2030 avskaffa den extrema fattigdomen för alla människor överallt. Med extrem fattigdom avses för närvarande människor som lever på mindre än 1,25 US-dollar per dag.

1.4 - By 2030, ensure that all men and women, in particular the poor and the vulnerable, have equal rights to economic resources, as well as access to basic services, ownership and control over land and other forms of property, inheritance, natural resources, appropriate new technology and financial services, including microfinance.

1.4 - Senast 2030 säkerställa att alla män och kvinnor, i synnerhet de fattiga och de utsatta, har lika rätt till ekonomiska resurser, tillgång till grundläggande tjänster, möjlighet att äga och kontrollera mark och andra former av egendom samt tillgång till arv, naturresurser, lämplig ny teknik och finansiella tjänster, inklusive mikrokrediter.
16.10 - 0 Säkerställa allmän tillgång till information och skydda grundläggande friheter, i enlighet med nationell lagstiftning och internationella avtal.
16.10 - Ensure public access to information and protect fundamental freedoms, in accordance with national legislation and international agreements.
16.5 - Substantially reduce corruption and bribery in all their forms.
16.5 - Väsentligt minska alla former av korruption och mutor.
16.6 - Bygga upp effektiva och transparenta institutioner med ansvarsutkrävande på alla nivåer.
16.6 - Develop effective, accountable and transparent institutions at all levels.
3.6 - By 2020, halve the number of global deaths and injuries from road traffic accidents.
3.6 - Till 2020 halvera antalet dödsfall och skador i vägtrafikolyckor i världen.

3.8 - Achieve universal health coverage, including financial risk protection, access to quality essential health-care services and access to safe, effective, quality and affordable essential medicines and vaccines for all.

3.8 - Åstadkomma allmän hälso- och sjukvård för alla, som även skyddar mot ekonomisk risk, tillgång till grundläggande hälso- och sjukvård av god kvalitet liksom tillgång till säkra, effektiva och ekonomiskt överkomliga grundläggande läkemedel och vaccin av god kvalitet.

3.c - Substantially increase health financing and the recruitment, development, training and retention of the health workforce in developing countries, especially in least developed countries and small island developing States.

3.c - Väsentligt stärka finansieringen av hälso- och sjukvården liksom insatserna för att rekrytera, utveckla, utbilda och behålla hälso- och sjukvårdspersonal i utvecklingsländerna, särskilt i de minst utvecklade länderna och små önationer under utveckling.
5.5 - Ensure women’s full and effective participation and equal opportunities for leadership at all levels of decision-making in political, economic and public life.
5.5 - Tillförsäkra kvinnor fullt och faktiskt deltagande och lika möjligheter till ledarskap på alla beslutsnivåer i det politiska, ekonomiska och offentliga livet.

5.6 - Ensure universal access to sexual and reproductive health and reproductive rights as agreed in accordance with the Programme of Action of the International Conference on Population and Development and the Beijing Platform for Action and the outcome documents of their review conferences.

5.6 - Säkerställa allmän tillgång till sexuell och reproduktiv hälsa och reproduktiva rättigheter i enlighet med överenskommelserna i handlingsprogrammet från den internationella konferensen om befolkning och utveckling, Pekingplattformen samt slutdokumenten från respektive översynskonferenser.
